item.title: Duct Leaks Explained: Why Some Rooms Never Feel Right (and Bills Climb)
item.description:
Quick Answer

Yes — leaky ducts are one of the most common causes of both problems. EPA and Energy Star estimate that typical homes lose 20–30% of conditioned air through duct leaks, holes, and loose joints, and that sealing ducts can improve HVAC efficiency by up to 20%. The classic tell: rooms farthest from the air handler suffer first, and the system runs longer and longer while the house never quite settles.
